scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-editor.mjs
scripts.smoke:graph-editor: npm run build && npx --package=playwright node scripts/graph-editor-smoke.mjs
scripts.smoke:daily-capture: npm run build && npx --package=playwright node scripts/daily-capture-smoke.mjs
scripts.smoke:lexical: npm run build && npx --package=playwright node scripts/lexical-editor-smoke.mjs
scripts.smoke:page-references: npm run build && npx --package=playwright node scripts/page-reference-editor-smoke.mjs && npx --package=playwright node scripts/reference-autocomplete-smoke.mjs && npx --package=playwright node scripts/page-reference-smoke.mjs
scripts.cli:release:local: npm run cli:version -- prerelease --preid local && npm run validate && npm run cli:pack
